blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Jose Rizal University returned to the win column in Group A of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament with a 94-69 rout of Lyceum on Tuesday at San Juan Arena. Coming off a three-point loss to San Beda on Saturday, the Heavy Bombers improved to 3-1, tying Benilde atop the group. “Luckily we have kids who are battle-tested,” JRU coach Nani Epondulan said. “All we’re missing now is a bit of maturity. Most of my players now are either rookies or sophomores. Fortunately, we got the win today.” JRU held a slim 25-22 lead after the first quarter before […]...
